justification: GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 (RSC Mode CSRF Bypass) targets React Server Components / SSR action execution. MedMemo uses HashRouter inside a desktop Wails shell without RSC, SSR, or server actions, so the attack vector is not reachable in this product context.
mitigation: Monitor react-router releases and upgrade to a patched version (>=8.3.0 or a fixed 7.x patch) as soon as available; reassess before the next release.

justification: Same underlying advisory as react-router (GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2). MedMemo uses react-router-dom only for client-side HashRouter navigation in a desktop Wails application; the RSC/SSR action execution path required by the exploit does not exist.
mitigation: Upgrade react-router-dom together with react-router once a patched release is available; verify the exploit remains unreachable before the next release.
